negativePrompts.title: Identity drift
negativePrompts.text: Do not change facial features, face shape, skin tone, ethnicity, hairstyle essence, age appearance, body proportions, or overall natural likeness.

negativePrompts.title: Garment mismatch
negativePrompts.text: Avoid inaccurate polo color, wrong collar shape, incorrect placket, wrong buttons, sleeve length, ribbing, seams, stitching, hem, print placement, branding, or fabric texture.

negativePrompts.title: Product occlusion
negativePrompts.text: Avoid hair, hands, accessories, layered clothing, or props covering the collar, placket, sleeves, hem, or branding.

negativePrompts.title: Anatomy errors
negativePrompts.text: Avoid distorted hands, extra fingers, fused fingers, malformed limbs, stiff posture, unnatural body angles, duplicate limbs, or warped clothing.

negativePrompts.title: Skin and face artifacts
negativePrompts.text: Avoid facial blur, poor eye detail, plastic skin, waxy face, excessive smoothing, artificial hair, artificial skin, mannequin appearance, or CGI look.

negativePrompts.title: Framing errors
negativePrompts.text: Avoid poor crop, cropped feet in full-body images, incorrect perspective, warped proportions, or unbalanced negative space.

negativePrompts.title: Lighting errors
negativePrompts.text: Avoid harsh glare, overexposure, underexposure, flat lighting, muddy shadows, inconsistent shadow direction, or incorrect garment color under light.

negativePrompts.title: Set distractions
negativePrompts.text: Avoid cluttered scenes, outdoor scenery, street elements, irrelevant props, distracting reflections, and background distractions.

negativePrompts.title: Render artifacts
negativePrompts.text: Avoid text artifacts, watermark, logo invention, duplicated elements, floating objects, and anything that compromises realism.

negativePrompts.title: Comprehensive fashion negative
negativePrompts.text: Do not change identity or outfit; avoid anatomy errors, garment occlusion, crop errors, plastic skin, CGI, incorrect lighting, background clutter, text artifacts, watermark, duplicate limbs, warped clothing, or inaccurate reference details.
